relationships.evidence_quote: it decreased allodynia in peripheral neuropathy induced by oxaliplatin or formalin, but not following spared nerve injury of the sciatic nerve (SNI)

key_findings: PGA binds MD-2 (3:1 stoichiometry in simulations) and acts as a TLR4 antagonist, blocking LPS-induced NF-κB activation in RAW264.7 cells.
PGA reduced LPS-induced keratitis, corneal cytokines and VEGF, and prevented oxaliplatin- and formalin-induced allodynia but not SNI allodynia.
